Title: 从专用模型到预训练模型
Subtitle: 先学习可复用的表示，再面向具体任务适配
Main LEFT about53%: concise comparison of two workflows. Top labelled “逐任务建模（简化）”, three parallel small flow rows:
“分类数据 → 独立训练 → 分类模型”
“抽取数据 → 独立训练 → 抽取模型”
“问答数据 → 独立训练 → 问答模型”.
Lower labelled “预训练后适配”. A clear shared backbone: “大量文本” → “预训练模型”, then split into THREE task branches “分类适配”“抽取适配”“问答适配”. Arrows fan out from the pretrained model toward task-specific versions, do not suggest no further training or one single fixed model does all tasks simultaneously.
A short line under this diagram “不同任务从共同的预训练参数出发，再使用任务数据适配。”
RIGHT about42%: scholarly historical case “BERT · 2018”.
Input2 contains the genuine original Figure1 at the top. Place a clean figure insert approximately x800 y400 width590 height238. Crop only original architecture artwork with Pre-training/Fine-Tuning labels, exclude surrounding paper prose. Leave it on a pure white backing so exact original can be placed later. Caption immediately below “BERT原论文图1｜Devlin等，2018预印本”.
Under the figure a compact learning objective example:
“掩码预测示意”
“今天的天气 [MASK]” → “很好”
“结合左右上下文学习表示，并配合句间关系任务。”
This is a fabricated pedagogical mask example, label it “教学示意”.
Lower full-width paired short statements:
“改变的是复用方式：减少重复学习，便于迁移到新任务。”
“BERT主要学习双向表示；生成式对话模型通常采用不同训练目标。”
Page17 bottom-right. No claim BERT is a chat generator, no invented accuracy or cost savings.

用户：“用一句话解释数据仓库。”
AI：“数据仓库按统一口径组织数据，支持分析与报表。”

Title: 近年的发展重点
Subtitle: 推理、多模态、开放模型与智能体，构成相互交织的发展方向
Upper body timeline across2024—2026, exactly THREE dated anchors, each event type clearly distinguished:
“2024.05.13” / “产品发布” / “GPT-4o” / “展示文本、视觉与音频结合的交互方向”
“2025.01.22” / “论文预印本” / “DeepSeek-R1” / “研究强化学习与推理能力的联系”
“2026” / “年度报告” / “AI Index 2026” / “汇总能力、应用与治理的年度观察”
Do not label the paper submission as the product release, do not claim every modality was generally available on launch day. Timeline is historical anchors, not a progression making previous methods obsolete.
Below timeline, four readable capability explanation rows, each heading and concise scenario:
“推理” / “数学与代码等可验证任务；训练方法与推理时计算共同受关注。”
“多模态” / “联合处理文本、图像、音频等信息，例如看图问答。”
“开放模型” / “开放权重与使用许可支持研究及部署；开放程度需具体核对。”
“智能体” / “模型结合工具执行多步任务，同时核验中间与最终结果。”
Flat two-column arrangement acceptable, no repeated oversized cards. Four headings must all fit and remain easy to scan.
A lower scholarly strip: input2 is REAL R1 paper page. Crop its heading/brand portion only (not abstract, body prose or benchmark chart), place in a pure white insert region x760 y750 width620 height170; caption “DeepSeek-R1研究材料，2025”.
Beside it a short highlighted explanation “R1案例：强化学习是重要研究路径之一，完整系统还包含其他训练环节。”
A compact line “方向概览属于趋势归纳，具体能力须按任务、版本和评测条件核验。”
Bottom bold takeaway “看清研究方向和实际任务表现，比记住一张实时排名更有价值。”
Page19. No live winner, top model ranking, fabricated percentages, forecast disguised as2026 fact or “open weights means unrestricted open source”. Keep density balanced, you can shorten other supporting lines if necessary but never lose four directions or event types.
